observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a single wooden pallet on a concrete floor.
Photo 2 shows a large stack of identical wooden pallets in a warehouse or yard.
The wood appears to be pine or a similar softwood.
The pallets have a standard slatted design with four corner blocks.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are visible on the pallets in any photo.

claims.evidence: The design in photos 0, 1, and 2 matches common industrial wooden pallets.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added. Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The pallets may be made from treated or chemically treated wood, which is not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or the underside of the pallet showing the treatment date.

risks.risk: The stack in photo 2 may contain pallets of different sizes or conditions.
risks.proof: A photo of the specific pallet being sold, showing all four sides.

risks.risk: The wood may be infested with termites or other pests.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the pallets.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the four sides of the pallet being sold.
Photo of the underside of the pallet to check for chemical treatment.
Photo of the pallets in the stack to confirm they are all the same size and condition.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as standard wooden pallets. While the seller's condition and weight claims are unverified, the item can be priced at its worst-case value as untreated, unsorted wood.
